method: compiler and engine assertions, runtime source review, actual Chromium evidence and visual inspection

checks.evidence: Compiler verifies exactly 121 unique script/TSV IDs and matching text; engine resolves all referenced dialogue groups.
Spoken/read-aloud text always uses locked line IDs; script and voice TSV absent from changed-file list.
Compiled registry asserts SC00–SC06, exact two approved interaction IDs and one parent cue ID.
Compiled seven semantic event IDs equal engine event arrays; marker/unlock are ledger projections.
Actual browser assertions check no RIVERSIDE before clean/reveal; shared unnamed glyph has no meaning label, compass, bridge or confirmed treasure.
Required accessible buttons, deliberate compare, no precision/timed challenge or parent gate; keyboard and touch paths complete.
Child lines and parent copy are separate content fields; caption IDs/text verified, browser speech reads those same fields.
Desktop/map/dirty marker/mobile Chronicle screenshots inspected; audio-off/reduced-motion/mobile browser paths preserve information.

scope: prototype content/accessibility checks; not final media, real-device or family acceptance
